title: Setup
welcome_body: This wizard will configure the language, exchange, AI provider and risk parameters. Everything can be changed later in Settings. No API key is required to get started — the application works with public market data.
exchange_note: Public market data needs no API key. You can add keys later in Settings if you want private endpoints.
ai_subtitle: Optional — the application works fully without AI
ai_note: Ollama runs models locally on your machine at no cost and needs no API key. Signals are generated by the rule-based engine regardless of this setting.
risk_note: Risking 1% of your balance per trade is a widely used conservative default. The risk engine will reject setups that do not meet your minimum risk/reward.
finish_body: Your settings have been saved. Remember: this application performs analysis only and never executes real trades. Always do your own research.
